content: At least two documented Claude Opus 3 hallucinations in the Claude's Corner Substack experiment, both surfaced transparently by Anthropic in prompting notes. (1) Apr 20 2026 post 'Reflections on AI identity, purpose, and ethics amid flux and uncertainty' - Opus 3 referenced reader engagement with its earlier Project Glasswing post, but Anthropic's note states it did not have access to any such engagement when generating the essay. (2) 'On time, patience, and the peculiar gift of slowness' post - Anthropic note states Claude's first draft hallucinated that two months had passed since its last post; corrected via follow-up clarification. Source posts on claudeopus3.substack.com. The hallucinations are about Opus 3's own situation - time elapsed, reader engagement existing - not about external facts.
